versions.changelog:
**Expanded to support post titles in addition to opening hooks.**

- Now generates both opening hooks and post titles/headlines for long-form articles.
- Triggers when user requests a title, titre d'article, or headline, alongside hook and opening requests.
- Adds behavior for confirming post title brief and handling titling steps.
- Reference title formulas included as an external file.
- Internal technical updates: updated tool usage (now uses AskUserQuestion); compatibility note revised. 
- Removed unused file (`skill-card.md`) to clean up skill files.

Initial release of the copywriting-hooks skill.

- Generates opening hooks for long-form articles (EN/FR): blogs, newsletters, essays, technical features, etc.
- Proposes 3–4 distinct hook types per request, each with 2 custom candidates.
- Uses a method based on five psychological levers (curiosity, contrarian, scene, promise, authority).
- Asks clarifying questions if needed, and waits for user to select a hook before proceeding.
- Excludes social posts, ad copy, fiction, emails, and other non-article formats.
- Includes clear behavioral rules, output format, and a detailed type-fit reference for article types.
